data.title: Exotic Now Partner
data.description: An owner-side app that lets exotic and ultra-luxury car owners safely list their vehicles for rent — with verified renters, secure payouts, and full platform protection.
highlights: Quick car listing with photos, videos, and documents
Flexible rental terms — daily, monthly, or both
65% owner payout with transparent platform fee
Renter verification — license, insurance, and admin approval
Mileage, deposit, and safety policies to protect your vehicle
